use_case_name: Create and Print a Voucher Batch

claims.content: To create a system-generated batch of vouchers with unique identification numbers, security protocols, and barcodes, and print them in a tear-off slip format for distribution.

goal.raw_text: To create a system-generated batch of vouchers with unique identification numbers, security protocols, and barcodes, and print them in a tear-off slip format for distribution.

claims.content: VMU User
The VMU User must be an authorized user with system-level access to create vouchers.
The system must have the capability to generate unique voucher identification numbers with built-in security protocols.
The system must be configured to print vouchers in bar-code format, including batch number, voucher number, and security code.
The system must support printing vouchers as three tear-off portioned slips with sub-sections for partner use.
The management team must have defined the minimum quantity of vouchers that can be created at one time.
An authorized user initiates the creation of a minimum quantity of vouchers at one time.

trigger.raw_text: An authorized user initiates the creation of a minimum quantity of vouchers at one time.

claims.content: The VMU User initiates the creation of a voucher batch, specifying a quantity that meets or exceeds the minimum number defined by the management team.
The system generates unique identification numbers for each voucher in the batch with built-in security protocols.
The system assigns a Batch number (2 Digit), Voucher number (10 digit), and Security Code to each voucher.
The system formats the voucher data including Project code, Group batch code, Batch number, Voucher number, and Security code.
The system prepares the voucher output as three tear-off portioned slips with a sub-section tear-off for the partner.
The system prints all codes (Batch number, Voucher number, Security Code) in the form of Bar codes on the voucher slips.
Each printed voucher slip contains the bar code of the Voucher with two identifications: one for the client and the other for the partner.
The system includes validity date information on the vouchers, which can be amended only at the system level by an authorized user.
The system includes MRP (maximum retail price) on each voucher.
The first tear-off slip is designated for the first consultation, the second for the first follow-up, and the third for the final (second follow-up).
If any of mandatory information is missed or any false information is existing then the field office will reject the claim back to VSP and the system will keep those claim in a quarantine area.

The quarantined forms will be sent back to the VSP for verification, if the VSP returns the claim with satisfactory details, the claims will be entered on to the system, in the following month's batch.
If the user is not authorized, the system will not allow voucher creation; vouchers are created ONLY by authorized personnel.
If the requested voucher batch quantity is below the minimum defined by management, the system shall prevent creation until a valid quantity is specified.
If password and verify password values do not match during user authentication or session validation, the system shall not save user information or proceed with voucher creation.

If an attempt is made to create a User Group or Individual User with existing names, the system shall reject the operation — implying similar constraints may apply to voucher batch identifiers if duplication occurs.
The system has successfully generated and printed a batch of vouchers, each with unique identification numbers (Batch number, Voucher number, Security Code) encoded in bar-code format.
Each voucher slip is formatted as three tear-off portions: first for initial consultation, second for first follow-up, third for final (second follow-up), with a sub-section tear-off for the partner.
The system records the voucher batch creation event in the Database, including Sales Details and Client Feedback linkage points as shown in the Functional Flow Diagram.
Bar-code data on each voucher enables future transaction verification, claim form entry, and selection of voucher usage by clients via bar-code reader interface.
Voucher validity date and MRP are embedded in the printed output; validity date can only be amended at system level by authorized user post-printing.
